hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.swift) out=$("$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/scripts/format.sh --paths "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" | rg '\.swift:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: (error|warning):' >&2 || echo "$out" | tail -20 >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
